plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: This app shares your location with your manager only while you are clocked in for a work session.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Background location is used only during an active work session so your manager can see your live position; it stops immediately when you punch out.

infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Location is shared with your manager only during an active work session and stops the instant you punch out.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Location is used to show your position on the manager map while clocked in.
